place.subtitle: From the wider region down to one AVA

map.credit: Maps: AVA boundaries from the UC Davis Library AVA Project, digitized from the TTB’s legal descriptions (27 CFR part 9); county outlines from US Census cartographic boundaries via Plotly. For orientation, not a legal boundary.

$why: Not an EU PDO or PGI or a US AVA: a country, state, region, group or sub-zone, with no shape of its own in the map data. The places under it that draw stay covered.
